entries.title: Psalms 36:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of Jehovah.>> The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 36:2
segments: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.

entries.title: Psalms 36:3
segments: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise [and] to do good.

entries.title: Psalms 36:4
segments: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.

entries.title: Psalms 36:5
segments: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the skies.

entries.title: Psalms 36:6
segments: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.

entries.title: Psalms 36:7
segments: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

entries.title: Psalms 36:8
segments: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

entries.title: Psalms 36:9
segments: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.

entries.title: Psalms 36:10
segments: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 36:11
segments: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

entries.title: Psalms 36:12
segments: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
